label: Introduction
subgoals: Divide sin(theta) by cos(theta) for tan(theta)
Divide cos(theta) by sin(theta) for cot(theta)
Exclude zeros of cosine for tan, of sine for cot

label: Tangent
subgoals: Read tan(theta) as segment ST on the line x = 1
Prove similarity OST ~ ORP for the sin/cos ratio
Restrict theta != pi/2 + k*pi where cosine vanishes

label: Common values of the tangent
subgoals: Recall tan 0 = 0, tan pi/6 = 1/sqrt(3), tan pi/4 = 1
Read tan pi/3 = sqrt(3) with sign flips for negatives
